sound_properties: immutable row and fold alignment with checksums
one historical OOF prediction per row
post-processing threshold selection excludes the nominal scoring fold
connected safe mask removes every crossing component under exact full-text and exact first-image-fp16 edges
large consistent negative deltas remain useful rejection evidence

limitations.historical_folds: grouped_text_v1 was imported from historical OOF assignments; current group hashes were attached later
limitations.selector_leakage: donor hard-mining uses global OOF scores whose generating model may have trained on the nominal outer holdout
limitations.adaptive_reuse: the same five folds and row-level errors informed dozens of later hypotheses
limitations.rank_normalization: within-holdout rank normalization is label-free but transductive and may shift on hidden batches

required_counterchecks: retain immutable historical validation for comparability
build a label-blind cross-category semantic and perceptual family graph using all gallery images
seal a component-level inductive holdout before the next deep candidate
rebuild selector uncertainty scores, hard mining, fusion and thresholds strictly inside each outer-train set
build prior vocabularies and neighbor indices from donors only
